pages.text:
Cooks Bitumen, the bottom of the barrel, down into Petroleum Coke, Refinery Gas and a little Heavy Oil.
- 250 mB Bitumen makes 1 Petroleum Coke, 50 mB Refinery Gas and 50 mB Heavy Oil in 3 seconds, using 25 HU/t at 420°C or hotter.
- Bitumen in the top, heat into the bottom, the coke (with auto-eject) and the Heavy Oil out of the left and the gas out of the right. The Heavy Oil goes back to the Cracking Unit.
# Petroleum Coke
It works as Coal Coke everywhere: Arcforge Furnace fuel and reagent, Graphite, the Gasifier, the Firebox Array, and furnaces. It's tagged c:coal_coke.
